question: Should OpenClaw keep this as the broader memory-management consistency tracker, close it in favor of narrower memory role-slot and CRUD items, or adopt a new unified memory.type-style config contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public config, plugin/runtime ownership, memory write behavior, docs, and doctor migration semantics; source inspection shows no single existing path already settles those product/API choices.

options.title: Keep Broader Contract Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the memory contract and coordinate the role-slot, backend, flush, and memory MVP slices under it.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Items
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42651 fully cover the remaining product work.

options.title: Adopt memory.type Direction
options.body: Sponsor a new config/doctor/docs design around builtin-only, qmd-only, and mixed modes, accepting the added public config surface and migration cost.

recommendation.title: Keep Broader Contract Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the memory contract and coordinate the role-slot, backend, flush, and memory MVP slices under it.

likelyOwner.reason: Current memory-core, plugin-boundary, and repo policy history make steipete the best visible routing candidate for the product/API decision.
